claims.text: OpenAI's page states users estimated under 18, or stating age 13-17, are automatically placed into ChatGPT for Teens.
For under-18 users the page states age-appropriate safeguards that reduce exposure to harmful or developmentally inappropriate content while preserving learning/creation.
The captured body references Study Mode among teen-support features (12 mentions) alongside parental controls, the Under-18 Model Spec, Teen Safety Blueprint, and age prediction.

limitations.text: Effectiveness of age estimation and safeguards is vendor-described; no independent test data in captured bytes.
